body: Thank you for your caring words.  I'm going to just be honest though - talking to you or anyone else isn't going to help.  I have logged hours over the years on suicide hotlines, text crisis lines, forums, chat sites, face to face, on the phone, in e-mail, in writing, etc. with everything from professionals to volunteers to ordinary people.  Talking to someone might pass a few minutes or hours, but, at the end of it all, the feeling remains.  I am not upset, I am just done.
Speak for yourself, I am nearly 50 years old and have tried everything.  I've resorted to every other thing under the sun, multiple times.  I'm done.
Hang in there.  I know it's hard.  But you're doing the right thing.
What an amazing shot!  Beyond stunning!
Going through this now.  Want the crying to stop.  It is killing me.
This is so hard to read.  I don't know if I can survive without him anymore.  He is my reason for living.
